description: Samsung One UI-inspired live activity bar for the Windows taskbar, with media controls, timers, sports scores, weather, and system status.
notes: Detect It Easy 3.21 identifies the vendor setup EXE as PE64 compiled with Rust (Direct2D and OpenGL libraries); it does not identify NSIS or Inno Setup. The upstream setup is a custom Rust/Slint installer. 7-Zip 26.04 recognized it as PE and reported 20 extracted items, but did not expose the application payload, so this manifest does not use the setup EXE or #/dl.7z.
nowbar.exe and nowbar-settings.exe must remain together in the same application directory; both official release assets are downloaded side by side.
Settings are stored under %APPDATA%\NowBar and logs and other local data under %LOCALAPPDATA%\NowBar. These locations are outside Scoop and are not removed by Scoop uninstall.
Now Bar includes a built-in updater that replaces its EXE files in the application directory. Prefer updating through Scoop; an in-app update may modify files managed by Scoop.
Windows 10 version 1809 or later and Windows 11 are supported.
